injuries.name: Jonah Gadjovich
injuries.note: It's a step in the right direction for Gadjovich, who hasn't played since Oct. 25, 2025, against the Golden Knights, missing over a year of action. Given his extended layoff, the winger's return to practice doesn't mean he will be returning soon. Still, Gadjovich should slot into a bottom-six role for the club once given the all-clear.

injuries.name: Andre Burakovsky
injuries.note: When exactly Burakovsky gets into the lineup isn't totally clear, but at least fantasy managers have a rough timeline to work with. In his eight outings this season, the 31-year-old winger has yet to register a point while producing just three shots, three hits and two PIM. Whenever Burakovsky does return, it figures to be in a bottom-six role.

injuries.name: Warren Foegele
injuries.note: Foegele has been sidelined since late October, and he initially carried a return timetable of 3-4 weeks. While he hasn't yet entered that window, the fact that he hasn't yet resumed skating suggests that he isn't particularly close to returning to game action. A better idea of the 30-year-old's timetable to return will likely come into focus once he's cleared to return to the ice.

injuries.name: William Eklund
injuries.note: Eklund's timeline would seem to indicate that he will be out of action until the calendar flips to 2027, though it's possible he makes a late-December return if on the early side of his timeline. While the 24-year-old winger is already on injured reserve, he could be a candidate for long-term injured reserve if the Senators need the cap space to make a move.

injuries.name: Jonah Gadjovich
injuries.note: Neck: The Florida Panthers said that Gadjovich took the ice on Thursday (Nov. 19) in a non-contact sweater, per George Richards of Florida Hockey Now.

injuries.name: Andre Burakovsky
injuries.note: Lower Body: The Ottawa Senators said that Burakovsky will be with the team for their four-game road trip and is expected to play at some point, per Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia.

injuries.name: William Eklund
injuries.note: Ankle: The Ottawa Senators said on Thursday (Oct. 15) that Eklund is expected to miss the next 10-12 weeks.

injuries.name: Warren Foegele
injuries.note: Knee: The Ottawa Senators said that Foegele hasn't resumed skating as of Monday (Nov. 16).

injuries.name: Hayden Hodgson
injuries.note: Groin: The Ottawa Senators placed F Hayden Hodgson on injured reserve on Tuesday (Nov. 24).
